build_feedforward_layer: build a feedforward layer with a specified hidden dimension and activation function
build_feedforward_with_multiplier: build a feedforward layer using a hidden layer multiplier to expand intermediate dimensions
build_feedforward_with_dropout: build a feedforward layer with configurable dropout for regularization
build_feedforward_identity: build a feedforward layer with zero multiplier that returns a single linear projection
build_feedforward_custom_dims: build a feedforward layer with custom input and output dimensions instead of hidden_dim
